title: Minimum Path Sum (Grid DP)
summary: Find the cheapest path from the top-left to the bottom-right of a grid of tolls, moving only right or down, by overwriting every cell with the cheapest total cost of reaching it.

inputs.name: grid
inputs.label: Grid
inputs.note: Each cell is a toll from 0 to 9.

anchors.label: The start keeps its own cost
Cheaper of the cell above and the cell on the left
